<<<POU name=TempControl kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK TempControl
VAR_INPUT
    TemperatureSensorInput : REAL;
    SetTemperature : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    CurrentTemperature : REAL;
    SetTempDisplay : REAL;
    HeaterStatus : BOOL;
    OverheatProtection : BOOL;
    HeaterOutput : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    phase : INT := 0;
    heatCmd : BOOL;
    heatTimer : TON;
    coolTimer : TON;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
CurrentTemperature := TemperatureSensorInput;
SetTempDisplay := SetTemperature;
CASE phase OF
0:
    IF TemperatureSensorInput < 0.0 OR TemperatureSensorInput > 100.0 THEN
        heatCmd := FALSE;
    ELSIF TemperatureSensorInput < SetTemperature THEN
        heatCmd := TRUE;
    ELSIF TemperatureSensorInput > SetTemperature THEN
        heatCmd := FALSE;
    END_IF
    heatTimer(IN := heatCmd, PT := T#5s);
    IF heatTimer.Q THEN
        phase := 1;
        HeaterOutput := FALSE;
    ELSE
        HeaterOutput := heatCmd;
    END_IF
1:
    HeaterOutput := FALSE;
    coolTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3s);
    IF coolTimer.Q THEN
        phase := 0;
        heatTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#5s);
        coolTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3s);
    END_IF
END_CASE
OverheatProtection := (phase = 1);
HeaterStatus := HeaterOutput;
<<<END>>>
